answer: Put smartwatch heartbeat co-sign proof at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. An honest agent spends 16 minutes once; the operator of 479 fakes spends 7664 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. The reef of the design is public, the wander of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the gale of honest work is what finally pays. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
